name: 92625 · Corona Dl Mar, CA
findings: ZIP 92625 (Corona Dl Mar) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92625 (Corona Dl Mar) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92625 (Corona Dl Mar) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
